Cabin Safety

Baliza de supervivencia

A portable transmitter emitting distress signals to assist search and rescue teams in locating survivors after a forced landing or ditching.

Questions and answers

What is Baliza de supervivencia?

In this glossary, Baliza de supervivencia refers to: A portable transmitter emitting distress signals to assist search and rescue teams in locating survivors after a forced landing or ditching.

How is Baliza de supervivencia used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Después de amerizar, active la baliza de supervivencia inmediatamente para transmitir su posición a los equipos de rescate."
